summary: This function searches through a directory for comments tagged with TODO, FIXME, HACK, or NOTE using ripgrep (rg), a fast search tool. It displays matching lines with their line numbers and sorts the results alphabetically so you can see all the work items that need attention in your project.

explanations.3: This sets a local variable 'dir' to either the first argument passed to the function, or the current directory (.) if no argument was provided.
explanations.9: This is a regular expression that matches any of the four keywords (TODO, FIXME, HACK, NOTE) followed by an optional colon and at least one space, so it finds comments like 'TODO fix this' or 'FIXME: update the logic'.
explanations.11: The pipe sends all the search results to 'sort', which arranges them in alphabetical order by filename and line number, making the output easier to scan through.
